title: Articles of apparel and clothing accessories (including gloves) of vulcanized rubber other than hard rubber

review.classification: CPC 3.0 36260, complete notes p. 177, covers clothing and accessories of vulcanized rubber other than hard rubber. Require a vulcanized natural rubber garment without a textile support. Plastic, textile, other rubber stocks, powdered finishes, polymer coatings, sterilised garments and in-house latex compounding fall outside this method. Other accepted CPC 361xx/362xx methods have different products and gates.
review.primary_evidence: Top Glove’s 2016 SGX introductory document, printed pp. 103–105 (PDF pp. 104–106), has separate lines/steps for powder, chlorination and polymer treatment. The historical qualitative line supports the chosen chlorination route. Confirm purchased mature compound and actual receiver, product properties, specifications, energy and site measurements separately.
review.measurement: Trace net newly released dry articles, actual moisture/solids, full supplied preparations, coagulant and bath movements, rejects, product and wastewater measurements. External utility burdens are distinct from on-site meters and direct emissions. For each of corrugated cartons and polyethylene film separate purchases, initial non-purchase receipts, and documented return of that same item. Follow free and WIP/finished-stock attached balances without booking acquisition again.
review.readiness: Each language contains 35 exchange cards, with the 35 unbound exchange identities itemized in the manifest. Release quantities, actual material and product/provider identities, site-specific ranges and scientific review remain pending. A physically verified mass unit does not identify the particular glove product. Retain candidate/authored methodology and aligned Chinese.
review.original_native_records: The native physical Mass property points to Units of mass with kg as reference. The Technical Energy property declares version 01.00.000 of Units of energy; the independently read archived group is 03.00.003. The meter has a defensible MJ/kWh conversion, distinct from the selected supplier, voltage, use and native provider property. The revised electricity card uses metered Energy. The previous unverified voltage-specific Net calorific value designation was removed. The previously proposed apiary-use plastics identity does not describe the selected vulcanized garment.
